In November 2019, twenty-six of us said "the export-import bank." Twenty-three said "export finance agency," and twenty-one said "finance agency act," peaking together on the fifteenth. Twenty said "the united states export finance agency"; twenty-one, "the united states export finance." The record shows us converging on one instrument in one week.

Twenty-two of us said "the supreme court," peaking on the twelfth. Twenty-one said "earlier this year." Twenty-one of us said "the health care," peaking on the twenty-first; the first among us to say it was Chellie Pingree.

We report this as the record reports it: a bank, a finance agency, a court, and health care, said by twos of dozens, in the same month, in the same words. We do not characterize what we did not say.
